description: This PHP test class verifies the behavior of the CandidateRejectionAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes unit tests for API endpoints related to candidate rejection, such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete. The tests set up mock services and fixtures to validate the API's functionality, especially the update operation using data providers.

classes.name: CandidateRejectionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the CandidateRejectionAPI, testing various endpoints including getOne, update, delete and their validation rules within the recruitment module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific database tables before each test.

methods.description: Tests the validation rule retrieval for the getOne API endpoint, expects a NotImplemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update operation of the API with different test cases; sets up fixtures, mock services, and validates the update behavior.
